jobs.occupation: Product & Regulatory Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
At LIEWOOD, we want every product that carries our name to be safe, responsible and compliant – across global markets and in a regulatory landscape that is constantly evolving.

We are looking for a Product & Regulatory Compliance Specialist to ensure that our products meet legal, safety and regulatory requirements, and to help shape the future compliance agenda of a growing international children's lifestyle brand.

In this role you will combine strategic regulatory ownership with hands-on execution and translate complex legislation into practical business solutions.

The role

You will own product compliance across multiple product categories and keep LIEWOOD ahead of new and emerging legislation.

Working closely with suppliers, certification bodies, laboratories and regulatory consultants, you will lead testing strategies and certification activities, and make sure our technical documentation is solid and up to date.

You will also help build the compliance setup of tomorrow – developing processes, SOPs and knowledge-sharing frameworks, and supporting colleagues across Design, Buying and Production, so that safe and compliant products are built in from the start.

Your responsibilities

• Drive product safety and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle

• Monitor and implement new regulatory requirements, including PPWR, GPSR, ESPR, DPP and other emerging legislation

• Lead testing strategies, laboratory coordination, certification activities and technical documentation

• Prepare and maintain technical files, Declarations of Conformity, risk assessments and compliance records

• Partner closely with suppliers, certification bodies, laboratories and regulatory consultants

• Support customer-specific compliance requirements and sustainability-related documentation

• Develop compliance processes, SOPs and knowledge-sharing frameworks

• Train and support internal stakeholders across Design, Buying and Production

• Identify, assess and escalate compliance risks while driving continuous improvement across compliance processes

Who are you?

You are curious, structured and highly detail-oriented. You enjoy solving complex problems, building scalable processes and turning regulatory requirements into practical solutions.

You thrive in a collaborative environment but are equally comfortable taking ownership and working independently.

We imagine that you bring:

• 3-5+ years of experience within Product Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Product Safety or Quality Management

• Strong knowledge of EU product legislation and testing requirements

• Experience working with suppliers, manufacturers and testing laboratories

• Experience with one or more of the following areas: children's products, toys, electronics, PPE, textiles, Food Contact Materials or consumer products

• Experience implementing new regulatory requirements and managing product documentation

• Strong project management and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across functions

Experience with GOTS, GRS and FSC certification is an advantage.

Why join LIEWOOD?

At LIEWOOD, you'll have the opportunity to influence how compliance supports innovation and growth across a premium children's lifestyle brand. You'll work closely with passionate colleagues, take ownership of your area of expertise and help shape the future of product compliance in an evolving regulatory landscape.

LIEWOOD values responsibility, aesthetics, ambition, collaboration, professionalism and innovation.

jobs.occupation: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

• 
Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

• 
Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

• 
Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

• 
Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

• 
Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

• 
Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

• 
Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

• 
Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

• 
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• 
The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

• 
Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

• 
At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

• 
Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

• 
Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

• 
Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges.

jobs.occupation: Tenure track Assistant professor/Associate professor Position in Materials Science and Engineering
jobs.description:
Aarhus University, Denmark

The Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering at Aarhus University invites applications for two positions at the rank of:

•   Tenure Track Assistant Professor, or

•   Associate Professor

The positions are offered within the broad field of Materials Engineering and Manufacturing, with a particular focus on participating in the department’s research and education in materials engineering, durability, emerging and advanced materials, advanced manufacturing and surface engineering. The department seeks candidates who will help shape a modern materials science profile, in research as well as in teaching, and who have demonstrated relevant experience in the field.

Expected start date

July 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible.

Research Areas

We welcome applicants with a solid background in materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, materials-focused chemical engineering, applied physics, or closely related disciplines.

We particularly encourage applications within, but not limited to, the following research themes:

Additive and hybrid manufacturing

Including metal additive manufacturing, laser-based processing and welding, joining of metallic and dissimilar materials, post-processing, surface engineering, and process characterisation and modelling.

Materials durability and advanced materials

Including materials under demanding and extreme conditions, 4D printing, bioprinting, and biofabrication, surface modification, lubrication technologies and functional surfaces.

Applicants are expected to contribute to both fundamental understanding and applied solutions, with relevance to engineering systems and industrial applications

Research and Teaching Responsibilities

The selected candidates will:

•   Teach, contribute to, and develop courses in materials science and engineering, additive manufacturing, and manufacturing processes at different levels, from foundational bachelor’s courses to specialized master’s and PhD courses

•   Contribute directly to the further development of the materials and manufacturing science curriculum at different program levels

•   Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students

•   Attract external research funding

•   Engage in knowledge exchange with industry and research partners

•   Participate in departmental and university service activities

Your Profile

We are looking for candidates who can contribute to research, education, and innovation at an international level.

To meet expectations in this role, we expect the candidate to fulfill the following requirements:

-   A PhD in materials science and engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field

-   Substantial experience conducting high-quality research in materials science and engineering, with publications in leading international journals that match career stage

-   Experience in at least one of the research areas listed above, along with familiarity with experimental, computational, or theoretical research methods

-   Interest in interdisciplinary collaboration across engineering disciplines and with industry

-   For the positions as associate professor, the applicants should, in addition, have:

-   Documented teaching experience and a clear commitment to teaching and advancing materials science courses, from introductory undergraduate instruction through master’s and PhD-level study

-   For associate professor applicants: a documented record of self-directed research leadership, external funding acquisition, supervision of PhD students, and teaching and course development at university level

Who we are

The engineering field in Aarhus University is evolving with a rapid growth in student population, major research initiatives as well as through the establishment of a number of new physical facilities in the city center of Aarhus. We have comprehensive plans for increased activities in research and education, as well as public and industrial cooperation. The  Department of Mechanical and Production Engineering  within the Faculty of Technical Sciences has cooperation with universities and advisory service providers in more than 20 countries. The engineering field at Aarhus University is well established with extensive research activities, over 700 mechanical engineering students and a long tradition of industrial cooperation that we wish to extend significantly.

What we offer

The department offers:

-   research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment

-   an exciting interdisciplinary environment with many national, international and industrial collaborators

-   a research climate encouraging lively, open and critical discussion within and across different fields of research

-   a work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities

-   a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance

Place of work and area of employment

The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Mechanical and Production Engineering, Katrinebjergvej 89, DK-8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

Contact information

For more information about the position contact Head of Section of Manufacturing and Mechatronics, Professor Ramin Aghababaei (ra@mpe.au.dk / +45 9350 8956)

or Head of Section of Mechanics and Materials, Professor Michal Kazimierz Budzik (mibu@mpe.au.dk, +45 4189 3217)

Deadline

Applications must be received no later than December 8th, 2026.

Technical Sciences Tenure Track

Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:

• attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level

• to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists

• to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:

• access to research infrastructure

• capability development, including postgraduate teacher training

• a mentoring programme

• support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

• Lead and coordinate downstream development activities for assigned projects, working with clients and cross-functional teams to align on project needs and deliver outcomes.

• Plan and evaluate downstream processes, including chromatography using ÄKTA systems and filtration operations such as depth filtration, virus filtration and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Design studies and author practical protocols in close collaboration with laboratory technicians; provide scientific guidance during experimental execution.

• Interpret study results, apply appropriate statistical approaches—including design of experiments (DoE) where relevant—and communicate findings through clear presentations and reports.

• Contribute to process characterization, including failure mode and risk assessments such as FMEA, and author process characterization (PC) work reports.

• Support investigations and deviation handling by assessing technical causes, interpreting relevant data, and documenting conclusions and follow-up actions.

• Provide scientific and technical input to business activities and support the generation of information for regulatory submissions.

**Required Qualifications And Experience

**

• Education: Master’s or PhD in Biochemistry, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, or a related discipline.

• Industrial experience: 5+ years with a Master’s degree, or 2+ years with a PhD.

• Downstream development: Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture processes.

• Unit operations: Chromatography and filtration; ideally ÄKTA systems and TFF systems.

• Study execution and data: Ability to plan, analyze and report complex development studies, including statistical analysis.

• Project work: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with scientific rigour and attention to detail.

• Communication: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to explain technical findings clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Language: Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience

**

• Process Characterization and FMEA

• Viral clearance studies or activities.

• Commercial manufacturing requirements and biologics regulatory frameworks, including relevant ICH guidelines and BLA submission requirements.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), including experimental design, data analysis, and evaluation using SAS JMP

• Liquid-handling automation, such as Tecan systems.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**You take ownership, bring a practical can-do attitude and are comfortable working at pace. You collaborate closely with technicians and colleagues, communicate openly, and use data and sound scientific judgement to find a way forward as project needs and priorities evolve.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**We want you to have the opportunity to use your scientific expertise while continuing to develop professionally. In this role, you can expect:

• Scientific ownership: Take responsibility for development activities and influence how studies are designed and executed.

• Variety: Work across different projects, technologies and scientific challenges rather than doing the same thing every day.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with scientists, technicians, upstream and analytical colleagues as well as clients.

• Client exposure: Develop your ability to communicate scientific findings and recommendations directly with clients and contribute to project discussions.

• Professional development: Continue developing your expertise in downstream processing, process characterization, data analysis and late-stage development.

• Impact: See how your scientific work contributes to advancing biopharmaceutical processes towards later-stage development and manufacturing.

**A team where science and collaboration go hand in hand

**You will become part of a team where scientific knowledge, practical experience and collaboration are important to how we work. We value people who share knowledge, ask questions and are willing to challenge and support each other.

You will work closely with experienced colleagues across different disciplines, giving you the opportunity to learn from others while also bringing your own expertise to the team.

We believe that good science is strengthened by open communication, different perspectives and a willingness to find solutions together.

**Ready to make your next move?

**If you are looking for a role where you can combine scientific expertise, project ownership, client interaction and practical problem-solving, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through the AGC Biologics career site by **31 October 2026.

**Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system and cannot accept CVs by email.

**The Recruitment Process Will Include

**

• An initial screening interview with People & Culture

• An interview with the Hiring Manager

• A final interview, including a cognitive assessment and personality assessment

• A meet and greet with team members and a laboratory tour

• Reference checks

Applications will be reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We may close the position before the application deadline once the right candidate has been identified.

_Location: We can only consider candidates currently based in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area, as relocation support is not available for this position.

_At AGC Biologics, we are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. We assess candidates based on their skills, experience, qualifications, and potential to succeed in the role.

To support an objective recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your application or CV.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Process Lead
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape manufacturing processes from early product design through industrialization and serial production? As our Process Lead, you will have a key technical role connecting R&D and Manufacturing, supporting design decisions and building robust, scalable manufacturing solutions.

PE Nacelle Components hold end-to-end (E2E) responsibility for the performance and integration of all assembly steps within the Components area in Nacelle Segment. This includes ensuring that each process step functions effectively on its own, while also connecting seamlessly with upstream and downstream processes as well as multi-step system interfaces such as electrical connections, wire harnessing, hydraulics, and other cross-disciplinary technical elements. The organization ensures that no assembly step operates in isolation-every step must align technically, procedurally, and operationally with the overall product and manufacturing flow.

Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end Design for Assembly (DfA) and manufacturing process development for your assigned process area, from early product development through industrialization and serial production

• Act as the key manufacturing interface with R&D, shaping product design through DfA and DFMEA to ensure robust, scalable and assembly-friendly solutions

• Own and continuously improve global process standards and key process deliverables, including PFMEA, Control Plans, process flows, work instructions and process parameters

• Define and optimize manufacturing concepts, process architecture, assembly sequences, line balancing, tooling requirements and production methods to satisfy safety, quality, cost and takt-time targets

• Govern manufacturing process changes and ensure technical compliance, process maturity and readiness across the product lifecycle

• Support Manufacturing Leads and factories throughout industrialization, prototype and early-build activities, resolving technical issues and ensuring operational readiness

• Provide technical leadership and coaching to process engineers and designers, while supporting process standardization, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the global organization

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline

• Significant experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering or industrialization, we are looking for 8 years or more

• Solid experience with manufacturing and assembly processes, production systems and industrialization of new products

• Demonstrated practical experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, process validation and manufacturing process documentation as well as experience in Windchill / Creo and exposure to change management processes

• Experience with Design for Assembly (DfA) and engaging with product development teams to improve manufacturability

• Experience supporting prototype, early-build and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities through to manufacturing readiness

• Experience from an international manufacturing environment; this could be experience within automotive, aviation, heavy engineering/manufacturing, medical manufacturing or wind energy

Competencies

• Solid sense of technical ownership, with the ability to take accountability for process performance, quality, safety, cost and manufacturing readiness

• Solid analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and turn findings into sustainable process improvements

• Ability to assess product designs from a manufacturability and assembly perspective and translate requirements into effective manufacturing concepts

• Solid collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across R&D, Manufacturing, Quality and other global functions

• Ability to provide technical leadership, coaching and direction to engineers and process designers without direct people-management responsibility

• Comfortable challenging existing solutions and using data and manufacturing knowledge to influence technical decisions

• Clear and effective communicator who can operate confidently in a global, cross-functional engineering environment

What we offer

This role offers the chance to contribute across the organization, along with meaningful opportunities for career and personal growth in an inspiring, globally connected workplace in the sustainable energy sector. You will be a part of an international team with a motivated approach, ready to deliver results, which values initiative, accountability, and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions.

jobs.occupation: Senior Full Stack Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Department: Cloud

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Senior Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

**About the role

**We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end.

We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.

You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering.

**

What you'll do

**Building & shipping

• Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts

• Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software

• Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team)

• Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build

**

Team & growth**

• Take part in code reviews—giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better

• Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos

• Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team

**About you

**We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan.

**

The ideal background**

• At least five years experience since graduating from a relevant Masters program

• Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side

• Comfort working with AWS or another major cloud provider

• A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design

• Good communication — you can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer or someone outside engineering. And you can do all this with strong English fluency.

• Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring other engineers, or driving architecture decisions through to a decision

We welcome applicants from people eager to move to Denmark so long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can contribute to relocation costs for the right candidate.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**_

At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

__We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

Within this, you will be part of the ERP Solutions department, which consists of approximately 90 people (colleagues and external consultants). Drive DFO Template Design and Development

You will work closely with stakeholders, other architects, deployment teams, and support functions across regions.

• Create and review functional design specifications within your area of responsibility, ready for development and/or technical specification

• Own HA Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Template changes from design to successful acceptance testing within the sales- and customer service area

• Lead template maintenance initiatives, including design and prioritization

• Work closely with other Solution Architects from Global IT to ensure solution alignment across the IT landscape within our sales domain

• Collaborate with deployment and support teams to define resource needs for testing and training in our sites

• Proactively inform management about risks, challenges, and concerns related to new functionality deployments

• Identify opportunities for improvement and lead initiatives from ideas to implementation

• Act as 3rd-level support within your area of responsibility

• Work with our product teams on Hearing Aid product launches to understand requirements for our systems, ensuring proper design and testing of changes with their products.

• Support key decisionmakers in defining and implementing optimal solutions across the Demant Group

• Contribute to application roadmaps and support execution by identifying risks, required competencies, and inputs to project plans

Come and join us
